findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed employee handwashing yet not using a barrier to shot the faucet. Discussed with PIC and the behavior was corrected using proper handwashing procedures. Ensure the employees are aware of using a barrier to shot the faucet to avoid decontaminating their hands after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed an exposed wood on the shelving that holds the microwave. The coating on the wood surface appears to have eroded off overtime. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspectors that the surface will be coated with appropriate coating to have this corrected. Ensure that this wood is resealed/repainted to create a smooth and easily cleanable to provide a nonabsorbent surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The prep surface for the coffee is a double door cooler used for storage and not cold holding. The top surface of the prep area is observed to have an accumulation of sugar and other debris, especially isn the gaskets, that will need a detailed cleaning and then the surfaces will need cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: There is observed exposed wood at the mop sink where the sink is attached to the wood that is attached to the wall. Ensure this wood is resealed/repainted to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, an d easily cleanable surface.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a light switch in the back room that needs to have a plate cover installed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface that does not allow for the accumulation of debris inside the light switch area.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: In response to the complaint, the facility was observed to have a piece of baseboard removed form the men’s bathroom which is exposing the flooring/base of the wall behind it. Facility is going to reattach the baseboard to the surface of the wall to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: Ice machine observed to have orange growth on the baffle inside the machine. Unplug the machine, empty all the ice, and utilize a clean in place procedure for the surfaces involving a wash and sanitize process to prevent the potential contamination of the ice within it.
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The triple sink and the mop sink were observed to be in need of caulking where the metal meets the wall of the sinks. The mop sink has rust spots that have created holes that need to be sealed and the triple sink needs caulking to seal the gap where the metal meets the wall. Ensure these areas are repaired accordingly to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
